newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Biacore lists in Sweden at premium.
newsitem.headline: Biacore lists in Sweden at premium.

text.p: Medical instruments company Biacore AB, a unit of drugs major Pharmacia & Upjohn, listed on Stockholm's O-list on Wednesday at 125 crowns a share against an issue price of 106.75 crowns.
The share price quickly slipped back down to 115.5 crowns at 1115 GMT after almost 45,000 shares swapped hands.
U.S./Swedish group Pharmacia & Upjohn announced in November it would list Biacore through a global share issue, listing on both NASDAQ and on Stockholm's O-bourse.
Based on the introductory price Biacore has a capital equity of 1.04 billion crowns, including the 1.5 million shares which Biacore would issue in connection with the offer, the company said.

The companies said in an earlier statement that five million shares or the equivalent number of American Depositary Shares had been offered to institutional investors in Sweden and abroad and to the Swedish public.
The offer was about eight times oversubscribed.
P&U said the offer would reduce its holding in Biacore to around 49 percent of the shares and votes in the company. It said it would retain 374 million crowns from the issue.
